newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission wants to end Burma agriculture GSP.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission wants to end Burma agriculture GSP.

text.p: The European Commission called on Tuesday for Burma to be stripped of preferential trading benefits in agriculture amid growing unease over Rangoon's human rights record.

The Commission said in a statement that it was asking European Union foreign ministers to revoke Burma's General System of Preferences (GSP) for agricluture. It made a smiliar request in December for industrial products.
The Commission said it had launched an investigation into Burmese labour practices following complaints from international and European trade union groups.
Burma had refused to cooperate with the Commission during the investigation, the statement said.
The Commission said it had also confirmed the existance of forced labour used in the Burmese countryside and, based on this, had decided to revoke GSP privileges.
EU Foreign Ministers are due to meet in Brussels on Monday but it is unclear whether they will take a decision on the matter then.
